question: Is Taiwan TDCC shareholding-distribution data source/semantic/replay feasibility sufficient for L3 while keeping ownership identity and same-generation research lineage as separate unresolved questions?

officialSemantics.grain: security × weekly data date × holding bracket
officialSemantics.cadence: weekly ownership stock based on the last business day of the week
officialSemantics.identity: holding brackets do not identify institutional/passive/main-force beneficial owners
officialSemantics.license: government open-data route/free access; source-specific reuse terms remain provenance metadata

parserReconciliation.exactShareIdentity: sum grades 1-15 minus grade16 adjustment equals grade17 total shares

pitRules: chipAsOfDate is the ownership observation date, not firstKnownAt.
For prospective PIT use, firstKnownAt is the actual successful capture time unless an authoritative publication clock is separately proven.
Multiple market scan dates sharing the same chipAsOfDate are one ownership vintage for ownership-inference independence.
Official historical/finalized pages may validate values but cannot fabricate an earlier historical firstKnownAt.
Preserved captured snapshots with asOfDate/content hash are replayable; mutable current snapshots are not substitutes for immutable generation receipts.

scopeBoundary.D06_10: owns TDCC source semantics, brackets, cadence, parser/reconciliation and replayable captured vintages
scopeBoundary.D06_05: owns economic interpretation of ownership concentration and still requires same-generation lineage/identity-aware research for outcomes

remainingLimits: Official online historical retention is limited relative to deep backtests.
TDCC bracket data do not reveal holder identity or passive/institutional share.
Prospective research rows currently do not self-carry immutable chipAsOfDate/chipDefinition lineage.
No outcome/OOS evidence is opened by this source-feasibility promotion.

maturityDecision.basis: Official Taiwan TDCC source fields/cadence are frozen, production parser reconciliation and coverage are validated, chipAsOfDate is preserved upstream, and actual captured vintages have been read back in production. This validates Taiwan PIT source/semantic/replay feasibility for the data module itself.

exactNext: Preserve immutable same-generation chipAsOfDate/chipDefinition/hash into prospective research receipts. At L4, evaluate weekly ownership changes with vintage-deduplicated inference; do not count repeated daily reuse as independent samples and do not infer institution/passive identity from brackets.
